notes.title: 🚨 New game Out of Bounds is NOW AVAILABLE! 🚨
notes.content:
Hello, everybody! How have you been?

We're doing PRETTY WELL! Closing this crazy 2022 celebrating 🥳

And that's not only because our football team won the World Cup, but also because we have just released a new game on Steam:

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/53ceb798e992c68ae96c207c36012d92b474fc5d.png

Out of Bounds is a peculiar title that was originally created for a game jam the past year (Epic Megajam 2021). As a solo dev, I had 7 days to create a game that was later released for free on Itchio.

Since I liked the result of the jam, I decided to keep working on that idea for the next months and also some great devs (former colleagues from other projects) joined me to get the best results in visuals (Viktor Ahmed and Claudio "Scuzzo" Sagrera) and audio (David Levill) 🙌



THE GAME

Out of Bounds is a title about "creating" a game and "fixing" bugs... Yeah, it's crazy. You will pickup blueprints, compile shaders, test sound effects, drink a lot of coffee. But watch out for the bugs! Grab your Line Tracer and get rid of them 👾

https://youtu.be/U7Q1M-wRbMg
Things are starting to get better here in Saibot Studios and Out of Bounds is part of that process. I'm looking forward to bring you news about bigger projects in the future, but for now give a chance to this crazy puzzle shooter with humor and puzzles 🤓

You can follow Out of Bounds on its new Twitter account:
https://twitter.com/OutOfBoundsVg



NEWS ABOUT EXPLOSIONS AND GORE?

Hell yeah! The people at Humble Bundle created a new package of retro style first person shooters based on the one they did in March of this year 🔥

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/d71afde69b8306dbbb108c8e6fbcb9e42f3a60d0.png

This time, you can get 7 awesome titles for only 12 dollars, including our own Hellbound and the great Forgive Me Father was also added to the list.

A percentage of the sales will go to charity at Able Gamers and Starlight Children's Foundation ❤️

Hurry up! Get the bundle before the next 24 hours ⏲️



If you have a Twitter account, don't forget to follow us for more news:
https://twitter.com/SaibotStudios

Cheers and take care!

Tobías

notes.title: 📦 COLLECTION + SPECIAL VIDEO + MORE! 🪙
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/2baf71e0692653c469784f5518da8d0bd44810da.png


Hello there! How are you? How's your 2022 so far? 😎

From here, we have a few things to tell you...

As we mentioned you in our last post, this year we reached an entire decade since we started making games as an independent team in Saibot Studios. But it was just now that we actually make something special to celebrate it. Check out the special video!

https://youtu.be/S4-E40ce_Oo

Together with this video, we built and launched a collection with all our published games, including: the Doorways saga, Hellbound and The Black Heart 😈

> LINK TO BUNDLE <

Buying the games from the bundle, gives you a 15% of discount on all the titles. And if you already have one or more of the games included in the package, it will discount you the titles you're missing without needing to buy the entire bundle 👌



TENEBRIS SOMNIA

On the other hand, we receently announced our new creation: Tenebris Somnia. This is a very unique title by the great Andrés Borghi, creator of The Black Heart 🖤

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/3dc732cee7c111bb33503e507a649dcf3d66ae79.png

We're developing this project Andrés and I (Tobías Rusjan), together with a great team of artists. You can read more about it and the dev team in this other post we did the past week.

If you like the concept of the game, don't forget to add it to your Wishlists. We're aiming to have it ready during 2023 👍

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121510/Tenebris_Somnia/



OUT OF BOUNDS

In the mean time, I keep working on my little jam game Out of Bounds, a rare title with action, shooting and puzzles. We released a demo in June and it's still available to check directly from the store page:

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/53ceb798e992c68ae96c207c36012d92b474fc5d.png

My idea is finish the full game for the end of the year. So play the demo and add it to your wishlist if you liked it! 🙌

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1787100/Out_of_Bounds/



HELLBOUND... HELLBOUND?

This month we received the great news from our (now) former publishers that they're giving us back the IP of Hellbound 🤯

What does this mean?

Finally, we at Saibot Studios are going to start receiving sales from Hellbound on Steam. Since the release of 2020, all the sales went to the publisher because that was what we stablished: they recoup their investment first, and then we split; but we never reached that last step because they never recoup their part with the sales we had.

But now after two years from the release, they're giving us back the game so we can atleast see some of the sales. Also, we got back the full rights of the project to take any desision we want from now on 🔥

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/5d56edecbe4128de8d9912896496161a814e16f3.png

In March of this year there was the Best of Boomer Shooters Bundle, the first collection of Humble Bundle focused on retro FPSs. Hellbound had the honour to be included in that package, becoming the first argentinian game in participate in the iconic Humble Bundle:

https://youtu.be/ndqIlyYFVJM

Both the sales from this collection and also the sales from now on (September of 2022) at Steam are going to us at Saibot. Yes, finally!

But unfortunately, this aren't earnings for us yet, since we still need to recoup all we put to create the Hellbound: Survival Mode in 2016-2018.

So the future of Hellbound is still uncertain... The good thing is that everything has started looking brighter now, we'll see how things turn for our Hellgore in the next months 🤞



That would be all for now, people. Hope we have some more news for you soon, follow us in our networks to stay updated:

 Twitter 
 Instagram 
 Facebook
 You Tube


Cheers, everybody! Take care!

Tobias

notes.title: 🎂 10 YEARS OF SAIBOT! 🎉
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/7b810cd997a89e0c3e44b1a3488243164ef329ce.png



Hello, people! How are you? How did you started 2022? 🤓


In a day like today, but from 2012, we officially started a crazy adventure called Saibot that continues to date.

Actually, the very begginning was in 2011 with the conceptualization and prototype of what ended up being our first title Doorways (read more).


But it wasn't until March of 2012 that, after I partened with my Uncle and friend Ivan Rusjan, we finally started working as a team. We built the first Saibot "office", which was actually my room along side the bed and at my Mom's department, and we used some old tables as desks that my Grandma gave us ❤️

And from then, a lot of enechdotes and experiences started hapenning. With tons of fails and drop downs, but also with some wins, we were able to keep going to date doing what we love the most: creating our own games and delivering them all over the world 🌎

So I decided to take some time to build and share with you a quick recap of some of the main milestones we have achieved together with you during the last 10 years of Saibot...



2012: The Origin

 Started the team and office with only two members (picture)

 Started the development of the first game and saga: Doorways

 First public presentation of the game at the event EVA 2012


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/d9a7ea9b6833fb127135c0a1ac1a73a9c7a57c20.jpg

Left: Tobias Rusjan (me), right: Martin Voychisko



2013: Prelude

 Trip to E3 thanks to a contest we won at Indies Crash E3

 Approval of our first game at Steam Greenlight after a lot of big Youtubers played it

 Official launch of Doorways: Prelude on Steam (first argentinian game to be released on Steam after being approved on Greenlight)

 Launch of VR (virtual reality) version of Doorways: Prelude with the Oculus Rift Dev Kit 1 (first argentinian game published with VR compatibility)


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/7284455e8752bf7471fd8c426f1d49e7950547b9.jpg

Most popular Youtuber Pew Die Pie playing Doorways: Prelude



2014: Underworld

 Moved to new home-office with our own space

 Team got bigger with 4 full time developers

 Development and release of the second game Doorways: The Underworld

 Hosted a special event with Youtubers Alfredito and international guest Xoda (Chile) playing Doorways: The Underworld live

 Trip to Esquel (Chubut, Argentina) together with the development team (picture)


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/c679b99e4bf7fe08ac1620b56872e7961c403691.jpg

From left to right: David Levill, Sergio Juarez (my Father), Damian Teixeira, Tobias Rusjan (yo), Maximiliano Schneider



2015: Holy Mountains

 Team got even bigger with 6 developers working full time

 Started the creation of the biggest title of the saga Doorways: Holy Mountains of Flesh

 Release of an early version of the game as Early Access in Steam

 Published the first live action promotional video directed by Andrés Borghi (picture)


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/3cbde0802de6ab11d99a3696b008f75ae9c7cd9e.jpg

Dev team members from Saibot together with the cast and live action video creators (see tags)



2016: Transition

 Final release of Doorways: Holy Mountains of Flesh on Steam

 Built and release of the old version of Doorways: Old Prototype created in late 2011

 Started working on new series Hellbound

 Team member David Levill decided tattoo himself the logo of "Doorways" on his skin because of the love he had to the project (picture)


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/3ac04849ab6987f9a81b8ce7f204ebefe967ee22.jpg

Tattoo painted by Fernando Muzzio (main artist from Hellbound) over the left arm of David Levill (music director and SFX composer)



2017: New Beginning

 New team members were introduced for a much bigger project in Hellbound

 Recorded motion captures (MoCap) for animations of Hellbound (Hell Knights, Vladers)

 Built and published Hellbound's teaser trailer (picture). For the creation of this particular video, we did live action takes as references, then did motion captures (MoCap), and finally rendered everything with high quality specs; everything done here in Argentina 🇦🇷


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/ef74d4400d6d1c3adf4ac89a721dd304af39c413.jpg

Watch the first presentation of the teaser trailer at the expo EVE 2017



2018: Survival Mode

 Launch of Hellbound: Survival Mode as Early Access

 Created a Kickstarter campaing for Hellbound to complete the funds for the campaign

 Had a TV showcase with Santiago Do Rego and Sebastian Di Nardoon at TNT Sports about Hellbound's Kickstarter

 Allied with NGD Studios (currently named Nimble Giant Entertainment) to publish Hellbound's campaign mode

 Hellbound wons an Unreal Dev Grant for the development of the project (first argentinian game to get one)

 Hellbound: Survival Mode wons a price at expo EVA 2018 as best game created in Unreal Engine (picture)


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/c9f3becc315ac9143daa5282e07e34a79a98eb57.jpg

From left to right: Paulo Souza (Epic Games evangelist), Tobías Rusjan (me), Miguel Martín (director at ADVA)



2019: Campaign Mode

 Moved with the team at a bigger and better home-office located in the town of Vicente Lopez (Buenos Aires)

 Definitive launch of Hellbound: Survival Mode (first published argentinian game to have animations withe motion capture)

 Launch of Hellbound's demo (campaign mode) together with a presentation at EVA 2019 (picture)


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/79bddaa6553a1977e41a6bd2da46dcdfd8d69f3b.jpg

From left to right: Juan Caratino, Federico Tessandori, Fernando Muzzio, David Levill, Viktor Ahmed, Tobias Rusjan (yo)



2020: Hellbound

 Released the campaign mode of Hellbound (picture)

 Published the Mayhem Pack DLC with the digital artbook and soundtrack

 Updated the game with all the Kickstarter digital rewards at The Heroes' Cemetery (statues, headstones, busts and wall)

 Released a big update with new content for both games Hellbound and Hellbound: Survival Mode

 Published as Early Access the first game created by another developer: The Black Heart by Andres Borghi


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/eccd89c6364fcbc3c5f7679bbbc7ca2f490ef567.jpg

Hellbound's launch trailer



2021: The Black Heart

 Built and sent all around the world the Kickstarter physical rewards of Hellbound: game big box, hardcover artbook, CD with soundtrack, stickers, posters and t-shirts

 Final release of The Black Heart by Andres Borghi (picture)

 Published the Soundtrack DLC of The Black Heart

 Released the Chaos Bundle of The Black Heart, including both game and soundtrack (all items are on sale right now, don't miss them!)

 Created and published a mini game for a jam called Out of Bounds at Itchio


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/a3d08dc69a5703d303cc18f3500d682472bb91e5.jpg

Cover art created by Fernando Muzzio (Hellbound) for The Black Heart by Andres Borghi



2022 (coming next): Out of Bounds and MORE...

 Final release of Out of Bounds on Steam (picture). See the last development updates here

 And more... (news coming soon!)


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/c2342cb224aec4660f26d102c5607a2ed98079a1.png

Add it to your Wishlist!



And this right here is just a quick recap... We thank you all of you for being part of this adventure, for playing our games, for sharing them or just for writing and supporting us 🙌

We have more news to reveal you soon. So follow us on our social networks!

 Facebook
 Twitter 
 Instagram 
 You Tube


Cheers and take care!

Tobias

notes.title: New projects (2021) 👾
notes.content:
Hello, people. How are you? It's been awhile.

Tobias Rusjan here from Doorways, Hellbound and Saibot.

I wanted to let you know about the projects in which we're currently working at Saibot Studios. Let's start with the one next to release...



THE BLACK HEART (OCT 2021)

The game The Black Heart, created in its majority by Andrés Borghi, a very talented multimedia artist with whom we had the pleasure to work with for promotional videos of Doorways and Hellbound.

The past year we joined forces with Andres to publish his masterpiece on Steam. We started with Early Access, we kept improving the game and we finally got a definitive version ready to launch  🙌

The full game release is next Thursday: October 21. IN LESS THAN A WEEK!

So go to the store page and take a look. And if you like it, add the game to your Wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431780/The_Black_Heart/

By the way, the new cover for The Black Heart was made by one of the main artists of Hellbound: the great Fernando Muzzio

And the music for the release version is going to be remastered by the sound especialist of Doorways and Hellbound: David Levill



OUT OF BOUNDS (EARLY 2022)

On my side, during August I participated in the Unreal Megajam 2021, and I managed to create a little full game on my own in just 7 days 🤯

You can play that version for free on Itchio; but since I really liked the results, I decided to keep working on this project and to invite another great former-Saibot so we can get the game to the next level: the master of art Viktor Ahmed

The idea is to keep improving it for a couple of months and release a new version during early 2022. So if you like it, add it to your Wishlist as well!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1787100/Out_of_Bounds/



ARRAN: THE BOOK OF HEROES (APRIL 2022)

And outside Saibot, our friends and coleagues who helped us in the past with our games created together Pal'Sur Studios. They are working on an action RPG that looks and plays spectacular 👌

I had the luck to play directly with the creators. So I can really recommend you to add it to your wishlist as well, without a doubt:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1545080/Arran_The_Book_of_Heroes/



Don't forget to follow us on our social medias for more content:

Twitter
Facebook
Instagram
You Tube


Cheers and have you all an amazing end of the week!

Tobias

notes.content:
An update on a Wednesday night? Hell yeah!

How are you, demonic creatures from the depths of Hell! ? 😈


Today we updated the full game with the Steam Achievements and a bunch of new stuff. Check out this post right here for all the details!

So we're also updating here the Remaster version of the Survival Mode with some of those fixes as well, including Steam Cloud and Spanish language as an option. You can find the full list below 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32020252/d718cc361e676a2e903888fd39bde8057949afb7.jpg

Take care, everybody!

Tobías

CHANGELOG HELLBOUND v1.1.3


New features:

 Spanish language option added for all texts, including in-game and interfaces
 Steam Cloud added for saved games, progress and input settings

Bug fixes:

 Input configuration resets every time you reopen the game
 Video quality preset sometimes appears empty and doesn't work properly

 Smooth disapparition added to chunks of useless weapons, exploding fruits (pumpkins) and container fruits (green onions)
 Damage area of Rocket Launcher's projectiles increased from 200-800 to 500-1000

notes.content:

As I mentioned you in the 2020 recap video, during the first months of this 2021 I have been dedicating most of my time to build the physical rewards we promised from our Kickstarter.

But even so, I managed to continue working on fixes and improvements for the game. Among other stuff, the Remaster version of the Survival Mode now has...

-


CHANGELOG HELLBOUND v1.1.2

New Features:

Full controller support with keybindings and configuration settings: separated x-y sensitivity; toogles for invert look, vibration and move states by holding down keys

Bug fixes:

Missing secondary bindings for Next Weapon, Previous Weapon and Switch POV Side (now [Q] key as default)
Total ammo of weapons Indolora and Rocket Launcher was showing only one at a time in HUD
Country flags were not showing after finishing a survival arena

Improvements:

Options available from Lose Screens
Menus redone entirely: selecting flow, centered configuration screens, fadings, sound effects
Moving with arrow keys in all menus, including sound effects feedback for every movement
Survival "stages" are now called "arenas"
Confirmation windows buttons now work when you release the click/key, instead of instantly touch it
Sound effect concurrency reduced in menus skull-selection to avoid saturation
Total ammo in HUD is now displayed centered, in two columns and shows "----" when there's no ammo left
Tooltips with keycodes updated with gamepad buttons
Trying to escape from the death screen using keyboard or gamepad now shows the exit confirmation window
Sliders from configuration settings focused directly for faster changes
Logo back to basics

notes.title: 🔥 Hellbound: Flying Souls Update (v1.1.1) 🔥
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/506333d226fbc95ee57883f6635f105a22a35b8c.jpg

Major Update: Flying Souls (v1.1.1) 🌋

HELLo, soldiers of Hell! How have you been?

We’ve been in overdrive preparing things for the end of the year and have some explosive new stuff for you! Are you ready? Check this out!

https://youtu.be/1Jc_yza1upM
Since we released the update in August, at Saibot Studios we have been working non-stop fixing bugs, improving the game in general, and at the same time creating new content. So we bring you...


Flying Souls: The true new level 5 of the campaign. The most complex and varied scenario of all: with indoor and outdoor confrontations and with the highest amount of secrets: 10 (SPOILER: 3 of which are almost-impossible and combined); and aesthetically SHOCKING: a floating island in the clouds, with two huge rings rotating around it.

Pygon: a completely new enemy that’s different from all the rest. It flies, spits energy balls that deal area damage, and teleports to dodge your attacks. We also added this creature to the next levels, so we recommend re-playing them as well.

Ground Zero: We recreated the classic Survival Mode scenario that we launched back in 2018 in the new version of the game, and we included it both in the original game (optional) and in the campaign. Among many other improvements compared to the classic, the new one has high-quality textures, new and improved 3D models, character ragdolls, bloodstains on the stage, new animations and visual effects for weapons, remastered music, Hellgore character voices, and much more!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/bff2bb193701adc63fef2e5570d1d716da91a00c.jpg

Doing all this was an investment that was not in the plans. Our Publisher Nimble Giant supported our development until the August release and we are grateful for that. Although both teams were very proud of the product we achieved, the sales results were not as expected.

We at Saibot then decided to go one step further and invest what little money we had left to continue improving and expanding the game, thus giving Hellbound the closure it deserves. Unfortunately, we are far from the game recouping its investment or for us to see any revenue in sales and thus be able to continue expanding the game even more.

That is why this update that we bring you today is a gift for all of you who have been supporting us, so that you can enjoy even a little more of this crazy project that was so important to us. It won't be as big a gameplay extension as you expected, but this is because our vision (commercially flawed probably) was always focused on making a small, high-quality product in all aspects of the game by adding tons of handcrafted details in each scene, enemy, item, weapon, etc. That was always our main objective; in addition to (of course) invoking the spirit of the classic FPS that we are so passionate about.

Each level of the campaign took us between 3 and 4 months of hard work, with an incredible development team of 6 people (of which only 4 were full time). The levels are built by hand, without any type of pattern or modular objects like tiles. This makes everything look more varied and organic, which was what we wanted; instead of repeated and simple.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/50bf5b35fe32b20ece8bb66d579ebf92350fbdc9.jpg

We’re taking this update as an opportunity to say goodbye to Saibot's current team as we will not be in a financial position to continue supporting the team until further notice. Next year a new phase will begin for everyone, with new journeys, opportunities and new projects.

Thanks again to everyone who supported us, these past 5 years have been truly AMAZING, we grew SO MUCH and built something GREAT together.


We leave you with screenshots of the new content, we hope you like it as much as we do.

Cheers from the unstoppable team at Saibot Studios!

Tobías Rusjan

notes.title: Quarantine??? No problem 😎👉
notes.content:

We're doing very well, entirely working in Hellbound as always. But this time and due to the quarantine established here in Argentina because of COVID 19, every one of us is working from home 😎

Even though the project originally started with all of us working from distance, during the last year and a half some of us have been sharing the same working place.

We started at the old Saibot office located in Caballito (Capital Federal of Buenos Aires), and most recently we moved to Vicente López (province of Buenos Aires).

So we had to set up some stuff to get back to this remote working thing, but it's actually doing pretty well so far 👌

Below you can find us in our "caves"...

notes.title: 🤓 A year of progress 😎
notes.content:
Hi everybody! It’s been awhile, how have you been?

Today a year has passed since the conclusion of our Kickstarter, that’s why we want to make a brief recap about the state of the project 🧐

As you maybe remember, our original goals here were:

Finish the Survival Mode
Build The Heroes’ Cemetery for all of our backers
Create an entire playable level of the Campaign Mode to convince investors


Well, “let's go by parts”, said Hellgore while he was ripping and tearing a poor Vlader…

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31193015/af34e46cd1f6a23507f6632086ad59e629e4725b.jpg
Viktor (right), Fercho (center) and I (left) during late night working



THE SURVIVAL MODE

During past year (2018) we did some adjustments, but the real upgrades will come with the release of the Campaign Mode, since we’re going to make use of all the progress made there.

We can’t add those improvements to the active version of the game at Steam yet, because we’re still working on the internal structure of the engine. But we can tell you that we’re working with the experimented team of programmers at NGD Studios for that, so the game can achieve the best results in performance and porting 👍

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31193015/82eb8289b4ce725205866daa5f6f49615c3e94f0.jpg
NGD programming team during a master class



THE HEROES' CEMETERY

We decided that this place is going to be an entire level of the Campaign Mode, where all the immortalized souls (from Kickstarter and from our website) rest in Hell forever.

Since our last post on April, we have been organizing all the information given by you guys (names, photos, phrases), and we slowly started designing every headstone, bust and statue. Soon enough, there will be updates on this as well. Here’s a quick spoiler of the cemetery:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31193015/ee0b7304b3792e6bc43133de5cb53e834c29b0d0.jpg
A quick look of cemetery’s ground



THE CAMPAIGN MODE

So here’s where we have been dedicated most of our time, sweat and blood (mostly blood for sure).

As we’ve just mentioned you, we’re working with NGD Studios, who currently our publishers for Hellbound. This is allowing us to create, not only one single level of the campaign, but an entire episode ✌️

Right now 25% of the levels from the game have (almost) final visuals and audio; 50% count with gameplay placements (enemies, items, areas, doors, switches, Etc.); and 100% was already blocked out (”grey boxes”).

Today we have created more than 1000 props with materials and textures; 5 new items; 3 new music soundtracks; 1 new enemy, and more…

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31193015/e9d8271621aad31e94c3df415356f8f0a0a40080.jpg
Just a few of the many props created for the environments



We want to reveal final screenshots of the game very soon, but we’re still working on that, and we also need to find a better timing (a day before E3 isn’t the best moment of course).


Thank you for this amazing year! Keep on Facebook and Twitter 👍

Cheers from the team at Saibot Studios!

Tobías Rusjan

notes.title: Version Update v0.18.04
notes.content:
New update for v0.18.04 is now available!

Now we have Full Controller Support, new Power Up "Hell Speed", configurations for Crosshairs and a BUNCH MORE!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32020252/3b7790efcc8ee414a43cbcaa1c8976b122f910f5.png

We have been listening to all the feedback you guys gave us at the forums ;)

The new version is currently available at Steam. If you didn't receive it automatically, remember you can force it to update following this steps:
- Go to your library of games
- Right mouse click on "Hellbound: Survival Mode" > Properties
- Enter in Local Files > Verify integrity of game cache

Below is a list of the most important adds, fixes and improvements we have made ;)

And at this tweet you can find the official top scores from last version (v0.18.03):
https://twitter.com/HellboundGame/status/986988114324451328

The scores are now reseted with the new update, since the gameplay was affected ;)

Cheers from the team at Saibot Studios!

Tobias


----


v0.18.04


NEW FEATURES

- New Power Up: Hell Speed
- Full Controller Support (tested with gamepads from X Box One, X Box 360 and Play Station 4)
- Options-Game: Crosshair Settings (enable, image, color, size, opacity) with real time Preview
- Options-Controls: Gamepad Settigs (horizontal and vertical sensitivity, invert Look, vibration, invert thumbsticks, key bindings)
- Options-Video: Vertical Sync
- Navigation thru menues using only Keyboard or Gamepad


BUG FIXES

- Sometimes player falls thru the ground when dying
- Wrong screen resolution on startup
- Steam VR launches without sense
- Buttons from menus can't be selected in low resolutions
- Some Power Ups stay forever available after spawn


GENERAL IMPROVEMENTS

- Running using Shift (default) does not prevent player to shoot or change weapon any more
- - Sprinting (even faster than Run) is still available by holding both Run and Crouch keys
- Explosions from Rockets and Grenades now affect the owner
- Minimun ratio from Explosions of Rockets, Grenades and Fruits reduced by half
- Plants close to the shores moved to avoid player of hiding
- Menu fonts improved
- Saturation of main loading screen reduced to avoid seizures
- Power Ups sound effects improved and highlighted
- Power Up Hell Damage feedback reduced, and now it always breaks enemies when kills
- Thunder feedback when a Power Up spawns
- Player and enemies speed increased
- Bouncing sound effects added to Grenades
- New Crosshairs for Head Crusher, and zoomed versions of Simple Shotgun and Indolora
- Unreal Engine version updated to 4.19.1

notes.title: Version Update v0.18.03
notes.content:
New version v0.18.03 is now live! B)

Now we have the first Power Ups, a lot of Options Configurations, New Music and a bunch of fixes and provements!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32020252/71917c291c929b525bbb2c565eb5b4ae15165635.png

That's it, since the first release we have been working on fixes and improvements from all the feedback you guys gave us. So thanks for that!

The new version is currently available at Steam. If you didn't receive it automatically, remember you can force it to update following this steps:
- Go to your library of games
- Right mouse click on "Hellbound: Survival Mode" > Properties
- Enter in Local Files > Verify integrity of game cache

Below is a list of the most important adds, fixes and improvements we have made ;)

And at this tweet you can find the official top scores from last version (v0.18.02):
https://twitter.com/HellboundGame/status/974677493625053184

The scores are now reseted with the new update, since the gameplay was affected ;)

Cheers from the team at Saibot Studios!

Tobias Rusjan

---


v0.18.03


NEW FEATURES

- First 2 Power Ups
- Options-Game: Default POV and Default POV Side
- Options-Controls: Invert Mouse, Mouse Sensitivity, Key Bindings
- Options-Audio: Real-time volume adjustments
- Options-Video: FPS Cap, Field of View, Gamma, Motion Blur
- New music for in-game menu


BUG FIXES

- Mouse cursor disappearing on menus
- Enemies get stuck when reaching the top of certain props
- Loading tips with wrong key codes
- Too big and too small items on certain enemy drops
- Wrong collisions in certain parts of the level


GENERAL IMPROVEMENTS

- Health and Armor items highlighted for better distinction
- Shooting sound effects upgraded
- HUD icons updated for 4K screen resolutions
- Skull selectors from menu remade
- Application icon added
- Ammo received from weapon items and packs updated
- Armor absorption factor reduced
- 90's games style quit screen added
- Anti-cheat system working
- Level collisions optimized
- Feedback from damage received highlighted
- Default audio volume decreased to match standards
- Faster leaderboard reading system (UWorks plugin updated)

notes.title: Project Hellbound
notes.content:
HELLo everybody! How are you doing?

We want to share with you how we're organizing this project Hellbound ;)

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32020252/7dabdebad6b9e8baebe242932b7691ac67c9a270.png

Right now the game is about what you see here: a Survival Mode.
But our idea is to also create a Single Player Campaign. The thing is right now in Saibot Studios we're not in economic conditions to face a Single Player Campaign.

So depending on how things go during next month (March, 2018), we believe we're going to know if we can affort a Single Player Campaign or not.

The Survival Mode is currently in Closed Beta. Which can be acceded from the official site by two of the following options:

- By registering and waiting a few days to get a free key for the Closed Beta.

OR

- Paying and supporting the project, and in exchange receiving a key for the Closed Beta instantly, and then a Definitive Key for the Final version of the game when this one comes out.

The Final version of the game could be only the Survival Mode upgraded, but it could also include the Single Player Campaign. But unfortunately and as we mentioned you before, we can't guarated this last thing.


For any question you have, you can always ask us here or by:
- E-Mail: contact@hellboundgame.com
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/HellboundVideogame
- Twitter: https://twitter.com/HellboundGame


Cheers from the team at Saibot Studios!

Tobías Rusjan
